result.brief: 提出 LARC 框架，在连续隐空间中进行推理以替代离散 token 链式推理，通过课程式 SFT 与信息增益强化学习两阶段训练，提升统一多模态模型的图像生成质量与测试时扩展性。
result.reason: Continuous latent reasoning for unified multimodal models, bridging discrete token reasoning and continuous image generation; matches unified understanding/generation and continuous latent space interests.
